afbbddaea4f11c3657c5de1a201deeccd5c30347.summary: News report on APT37 (also called RedEyes or ScarCruft), described as a North Korean espionage group believed to be state-supported. AhnLab's ASEC reported a new backdoor, M2RAT, used in phishing attacks from January 2023. The attacks exploit CVE-2017-8291 in the Hangul word processor and hide the payload in a JPEG using steganography. M2RAT provides keylogging, screenshots, command execution and data theft, scans connected phones and tablets for documents and voice recordings, and uses shared memory for C2 communication.

Compromised websites host installers that impersonate business software such as HubSpot, Veeam and Xero. The report says Carbanak has been used by the FIN7 syndicate. NCC Group counted 442 ransomware attacks in November 2023 and 4,276 so far this year, led by industrials, consumer cyclicals and healthcare. Corvus counted 484 new leak-site victims. af70e2e4750a95aa3748fc15e3c1fb92f1b47e29.summary: Visa warned merchants using Oracle MICROS point-of-sale systems to check for malware and change passwords, and published addresses it linked to the Carbanak gang. The report says hackers exploited a file-upload flaw in MICROS' support portal and planted a web shell, gaining credentials for remote access to customer systems. Oracle has disclosed little beyond advising password changes. MalumPOS, a malware threat targeting MICROS in hotels, was also named. The same hacker may have hit at least five other POS companies.
